explain.title: Understanding Arrays, Lists, and Maps
explain.content: This lesson develops practical skill in Arrays, Lists, and Maps within 'Collections, Exceptions, and State'. Students apply Java-first thinking, then connect it to robotics execution and reliability.
keyPoints: Apply core Java concepts before FTC-specific abstractions
Use clear code structure and naming
Validate behavior through output or telemetry
Build toward competition-ready reliability
